summary: Show a command failure with its message and actionable recovery step in an accessible alert or notice.

useWhen.text: Use whenever an AFD command returns success: false with an error message and recovery suggestion.

avoidWhen.text: Avoid for empty search or list results where the command succeeded; use collection-states instead.

keep.text: Announces the failure in an alert or named notice region visible to assistive technology.
Provides an operable recovery control with an accessible name when retry or follow-up action is available.
Fits a narrow viewport without horizontal overflow or clipped error text.
Show both what failed (error.message) and what the person can do next (error.suggestion) in plain language.

customize.text: Place inline beside the failing control or in an embedded notice region depending on scope.

default.text: Mount a command failure from spec/wire/result-failure.json showing the error message, suggestion, and an operable recovery control.
